suggested_title: Sumeet Sharma - MD/PhD Graduate & Psychiatry Fellow at Emory School of Medicine
prospect_notes: Sumeet Sharma earned his BA from Cornell University (Ithaca campus) and his MD/PhD from Emory University School of Medicine through the MSTP (Medical Scientist Training Program), graduating in 2021. He is currently a PGY4 Child and Adolescent Psychiatry Research Track Fellow at Emory University. His PhD dissertation, co-mentored by Kerry Ressler and Peng Jin, focused on the intersection between genetic risk loci in humans and regulation of stress-related genes in animal models, with highly translational work pairing large genomic datasets from trauma individuals with animal models of stress. He has published extensively in journals including the Journal of Genetics and Genomics, PLoS Genetics, Frontiers in Psychiatry, and Progress in Neuro-Psychopharmacology & Biological Psychiatry, and received Honorable Mention recognition for the 2023 NIMH Outstanding Resident Award. His current research investigates immune system dynamics in the developing brain and how psychosocial stress impacts these processes in adolescent animals.
